svg.title: Architectural drawing
svg.desc: Elevation of a garden grotto: a mound of rough boulders with a deep, dark cave mouth hung with drips, a ring of scallop shells set into the stones round the opening, and a pool in front, shaded on the side away from the light, with a shaded round close-up of the boulders and shells beside the opening. Source: Original drawing by Project Exodus from the standard geometric construction of this form; no external drawing reproduced.
svg.text: SOURCE: Original drawing by Project Exodus from the standard geometric
construction of this form; no external drawing reproduced.
